title: N-glycomes of influenza-infected A549 organelle and secreted fractions
description: 131 released N-glycan chromatographic features in organelle and secreted protein fractions of A549 cells 24 hours after PR8 (H1N1), x31 (H3N2) or mock infection.
details: PGC-LC-MS/MS glycan abundances are author-normalized proportions of all glycans in each sample. Compatible organelle and secreted fractions are combined with explicit compartment and infection metadata. Four biological replicates per condition were planned. The O-glycan secreted x31 block contains only two observations in the deposited quantitative table; missing observations are not invented. Source isomer identifiers and diagnostic evidence are retained. The deposited N-glycan table contains 131 quantitative features, whereas the publication describes 142 identified N-glycan structures; this object reproduces the available quantitative matrix rather than claiming to include undocumented features. The corresponding molecular feature blocks in official Supplementary Data 4 were checked cell-by-cell and match the deposited workbook.
annotation: Source monosaccharide counts and author GlyTouCan accessions are retained. Where an accession resolves to a parseable WURCS structure with composition consistent with the source row, its structure is included. Unresolvable accessions, incompatible compositions and rows without sequence-level structure remain unfilled. Sulfate/phosphate identity is resolved only when the row explicitly names it; ambiguous substitution remains source annotation without a falsely complete composition. Glycans were chemically reduced for measurement; structures represent the source-referenced glycan identity.

additional_sources.comparison: Every cell of the molecular feature block matches the deposited GlycoPOST workbook; added supplementary rows contain figure-derived summaries.
